# Microsoft Detours

Source: https://github.com/microsoft/Detours

Revision: `1dbd4ea281d73d478aa8d09a8b83fbd265f715f7`.

Unmodified upstream C++ sources and headers from `src/`; license in `LICENSE.md`.
Only the Windows x64 library is built. RED PANDA's policy and launcher are outside
this directory. Updating this copy requires rebuilding and running execution
process contracts; a library build does not establish task interception coverage.
